metadata.case_name: TA A SAM v. HO KA CHI APRIL T/A FANTASTIC INTERIOR DESIGN CO

injuries.description: fracture of the right inferior pubic rami
source: X-ray showed fracture of the right inferior pubic rami.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of pubis without disruption of pelvic ring

manifestations.description: Unable to lift heavy objects such as carrying the oxy-ace cylinders
Unable to return to his pre-accident work
Psychiatric problems (complained but no psychiatric reports)

treatments_received.treatment: Immediate hospital treatment, x-ray and follow up treatment
source: The Plaintiff was then taken to Tseung Kwan O Hospital for immediate treatment. X-ray showed fracture of the right inferior pubic rami. He was hospitalized and discharged on 29 February 2008 for follow up treatment.

losses.description: pain and disability at the back of the Plaintiff

comparable_cases.case_name: San-To Po Yuk Hilter –v- Wing Kwong Painting Co. Ltd
comparable_cases.injury_description: the Plaintiff in that case fell from a ladder from a height of about four to five feet landing on his buttocks whilst doing some painting work. The injuries involved significant disc extrusion at L4/5 causing severe spinal canal narrowing. There was also mild postero-central disc bulge at L5/S1 level that caused moderate spinal canal stenosis. The Plaintiff there was medically assessed to have suffered 10% impairment of the whole person. The trial Judge awarded $350,000 under this head.

comparable_cases.case_name: Ng Koon Ki Peter –v- Hilti (Hong Kong) Ltd & Anor
comparable_cases.injury_description: the Plaintiff twisted his back and injured himself whilst grabbing a plank. Because of the weight of the plank, he was unable to hold it with one hand and he dropped the plank. He was awarded $350,000 for PSLA.

comparable_cases.case_name: Choi Chi Hung –v- Wong Kuen Bor trading as Bor Kee Electroplating Factory
comparable_cases.injury_description: the Plaintiff slipped over whilst at work and injured his back. Medical examination revealed injuries over the lumbar spine at L4 and L5. The award for PSLA is HK$300,000.

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Chi Shing –v- Chan Siu Kuen & others
comparable_cases.injury_description: X-ray revealed collapse and compression fracture of L4 vertebra and comminuted intra-articular fracture of calcaneum of the right ankle. He was awarded HK$350,000 for PSLA.
